body:
I believe these were incorrect for translations, so I changed how they use TTR.
It should now also be easier to extend if more placement options are added.

Looking through some code, I think `X-Axis` is more preferred.
I'll also update it in the tooltip too.
Indeed, `TTR()` should not contain conditions within it (the condition should be outside). Otherwise, the translation POT generator won't be able to read it.
